title: UTMB Live — The Canyons Endurance Runs by UTMB 2026, 100K
claims: The 2026 Canyons 100K started at China Wall on 25 April 2026 at 05:00 and recorded 678 starters, 138 DNF and 540 finishers.
The 2026 100K was listed as 62.1 miles (100 km) with 12,303 ft+ of gain.
